config:
[accounts]
active = "full"

[[accounts.records]]
id = "full"
name = "Full Record"
harness = "claude"
auth = "api_key"
priority = 3
route = "zai/glm-5.3"
account_id = "acct-full"
tags = ["work", "it's"]
description = "the full record"

[[accounts.records]]
id = "keyed"
name = "Keyed"
harness = "openclaw"
auth = "api_key"
[accounts.records.env]
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "${KEYCHAIN:item-a}"
ZED = "plain"

[[accounts.records]]
id = "oauth"
name = "OAuth"
harness = "claude"
auth = "oauth_dir"
credentials_source = "{TMP}/creds"

[[accounts.records]]
id = "alt"
name = "Alt"
harness = "claude"
auth = "managed"
config_dir = "{TMP}/alt"

[[accounts.records]]
id = "makers"
name = "makers"
harness = "claude"
auth = "managed"

[[accounts.records]]
id = "ready"
name = "ready"
harness = "claude"
auth = "managed"

[[accounts.records]]
id = "cx"
name = "cx"
harness = "codex"
auth = "managed"

[[accounts.records]]
id = "z"
name = "z"
harness = "claude"
auth = "api_key"
[accounts.records.env]
ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${ENV:SHOW_TOKEN}"

expect.stderr:
error: account 'ready' is managed and not the active ~/.claude account (active: makers). Per-spawn selection for a non-active account needs its own config dir: register it with a config_dir (e.g. --config-dir ~/.claude-ready, a full second login) so the worker gets CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. The setup-token env lane bills the wrong account and is deliberately not used.
  or make it active:  fno config accounts use ready  (daemon-wide)
